composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114, "BILGE ALARM SYSTEM") serves the vessel's bilge/fire pump loads and their alarm/monitoring: MAIN BILGE PUMP, MAIN FIRE PUMP, AUX MAST BILGE PUMP, and AUX ENGINE ROOM BILGE PUMP — each named directly on the sheet as a load driven from DC Main Panel or FWD DC Panel feeders, plus a Main Panel PC Card that aggregates bilge-level/run status (LAZARETTE BILGE, AFT BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, FWD BILGE, SAIL LOCKER) into a common alarm/buzzer with mute/test. The register maps MAIN BILGE PUMP -> 520-main-bilge-pump, MAIN FIRE PUMP -> 520-fire-pump, and AUX MAST/ENGINE ROOM BILGE PUMP -> 520-aux-bilge-pumps. The PC Card / alarm annunciator itself is bilge-system-wide monitoring infrastructure without its own equipment identity on this sheet; T/S/relay/bus structure (T/S S, T/S F, T/S B, T/S C, T/S E, F5, MU4-12) is shared panel infrastructure belonging to 640-dc-distribution / 641-vessel-control-panel.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Directly labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' motor at top-right, fed from DC MAIN PANEL via F3 60A / SW8 / SO 6 coil circuit, with local pump switch on T/S S terminals 13/14. Matches register mapping BILGE PUMP -> 520-main-bilge-pump. Established fact (engineer_redpen) confirms the multi-switch activation loop (local SW, main panel SW, ONYX remote XA11) — this sheet shows the local-switch/SO6-relay portion consistent with that established loop; do not re-derive beyond what is drawn here.

functions.label: Main bilge pump supply and local run control
functions.what_it_does: Feeds the Main Bilge Pump motor from the DC Main Panel and energises its run-relay (SO 6) via the local pump switch, so the pump can be started locally at the panel.

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel bus -> fuse F3 (60A) -> switch SW8 (open) -> SO 6 coil de-energised -> pump motor idle

DC Main Panel bus -> F3 60A -> SW8 -> SO 6 relay coil -> junction T/S S terminals 13/14 -> LOCAL PUMP SW contact closes circuit -> SO 6 energised -> contactor closes -> +24V feeds MAIN BILGE PUMP motor -> motor runs (return to ground stub, feed side traced only to SW8/F3; coil's other side not fully traced on this sheet)

key_components: LOCAL PUMP SW (local start switch, on T/S S terminals 13/14)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC circuit; fuse F3 60A; local switch actuation via T/S S 13/14; per established fact this coil can ALSO be closed by MAIN PANEL switch (plug C pins 6/7) and ONYX remote XA11/relay Re6 — those paths are not drawn on this sheet and are cross-referenced only.
functions.sheet_region: top-left DC Main Panel column (approx 0.03-0.42, 0.1-0.38) and Main Bilge Pump motor top-right (approx 0.85-0.95, 0.13-0.2)

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Directly labelled 'MAIN FIRE PUMP' motor, fed via F4 100A/SW9/SO7 relay, with two local switches (FWD PUMP SW, LAZ. PUMP SW) wired through T/S S terminals 16-19. Register maps FIRE PUMP -> 520-fire-pump. Established fact confirms this is a separate physical pump (same model as main bilge pump, Gianneschi ACB 431B) — consistent, not re-derived.

functions.label: Main fire pump supply and remote switch control (FWD / Lazarette stations)
functions.what_it_does: Feeds the Main Fire Pump motor from the DC Main Panel and allows starting it from either a forward-pump switch station or a lazarette pump switch station, via relay SO7 and terminal strip T/S S.

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel bus -> fuse F4 (100A) -> switch SW9 (open) -> SO7 coil de-energised -> pump motor idle

DC Main Panel bus -> F4 100A -> SW9 -> SO7 relay coil junctions T/S S 16/17/18 -> BR/BL/G lines to right-edge plug -> FWD PUMP SW contact closes (BR/BL/G) -> SO7 energised -> contactor closes -> +24V to MAIN FIRE PUMP motor -> motor runs -> return to NEG. BUS

DC Main Panel bus -> F4 100A -> SW9 -> SO7 relay coil junctions T/S S 16/17/18 -> BR/BL/G lines to right-edge plug -> LAZ. PUMP SW contact closes (BR/BL/G) -> SO7 energised -> contactor closes -> +24V to MAIN FIRE PUMP motor -> motor runs -> return to NEG. BUS

key_components: FWD PUMP SW (forward station switch, BR/BL/G contacts)
LAZ. PUMP SW (lazarette station switch, BR/BL/G contacts)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC circuit; fuse F4 100A; two alternative remote switch stations (FWD, Lazarette) both closing the same SO7 coil circuit through T/S S terminals 16/17/18 and a 3-wire BR/BL/G run.
functions.sheet_region: top-left DC Main Panel column (F4/SW9/SO7, approx 0.03-0.42,0.1-0.38) and Main Fire Pump motor + switch dotted boxes top-right (approx 0.62-0.92, 0.13-0.44)

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Two loads named 'AUX MAST BILGE PUMP' (Q2 10A/Re2) and 'AUX BILGE PUMP ENGINE ROOM' / 'AUX ENGINE ROOM BILGE PUMP' (Q3 10A/Re3) both fed from FWD DC Panel, each with a bilge float switch and an override switch, and both reporting run status back through the Main Panel PC Card. Register maps both AUX MAST BILGE PUMP and AUX BILGE PUMP ENG. ROOM to 520-aux-bilge-pumps (same node, matches BOM: Whale Gulper 320 for both).

functions.label: Aux Mast Bilge Pump automatic/override run control
functions.what_it_does: Feeds and automatically runs the Aux Mast Bilge Pump on rising bilge water (float switch) or on manual override, via relay Re2 and terminal strip T/S F, and reports run status to the Main Panel PC Card.

flow_scenarios.path: FWD DC Panel bus -> breaker Q2 (10A) -> relay Re2 contact open -> T/S F terminals 11/12/13 -> BILGE SW (float, open) and OVERRIDE SW (open) -> pump idle

FWD DC Panel bus -> Q2 10A -> Re2 contact -> T/S F terminal 11/12/13 (terminal 12 is a FUSED terminal) -> BILGE SW. closes on rising water -> +24V feeds AUX MAST BILGE PUMP motor -> pump runs, discharging bilge water -> run status returns via T/S C terminal (RUN IND. - MAST BILGE PUMP) to Main Panel PC Card lamp
FWD DC Panel bus -> Q2 10A -> Re2 -> T/S F terminal 12 (fused) -> tap 5 -> OVERRIDE SW closes manually -> pump runs regardless of float switch state -> run status to PC Card via RUN IND.

key_components: T/S F terminal 12 — FUSED terminal (built-in replaceable fuse; known troubleshooting culprit)
RUN IND. - MAST BILGE PUMP (status lamp on Main Panel PC Card)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC circuit; breaker Q2 10A; fused terminal at T/S F-12 (exact fuse rating: capture at inspection). Coil positive feed side traced to Q2/F5/Re2; the RUN IND. lamp's own positive/feed side is not traced on this sheet (see uncertainties).
functions.sheet_region: FWD DC Panel column mid-left (approx 0.03-0.42, 0.53-0.71) and AUX MAST BILGE PUMP motor + switches mid-right (approx 0.62-0.92, 0.53-0.71); RUN IND. lamp bottom of Main Panel PC Card (approx 0.55-0.92, 0.93-0.97)

FWD DC Panel bus -> Q3 10A -> Re3 -> T/S F terminal 15 (fused) -> tap 6 -> ENG.ROOM OVERRIDE SW closes manually -> pump runs regardless of float switch state -> run status to PC Card via RUN IND.

infrastructure.system_name: DC Main Panel / FWD DC Panel distribution (T/S S, T/S F, F5, F3, F4, SW8, SW9, terminal strips)
facts: T/S S (terminal strip) carries + SERVICE BAT and 500A SHUNT feeds (pins 1-3) and pump control loops (pins 13-19) — panel-side terminal infrastructure, not a distinct system.
T/S F (terminal strip near Re2/Re3) carries relay contact taps 11-16 for the two aux bilge pump circuits — shared distribution infrastructure.
F5 100A fuse feeds both Q2 and Q3 breakers from the +24V service supply — shared feeder infrastructure for the FWD DC Panel.
FWD DC PANEL itself is detailed on a separate sheet (see DWG 120) — cross-reference only.

infrastructure.system_name: Main Panel PC Card bilge alarm/annunciator (T/S B, T/S E, T/S C, diode matrix, buzzer/alarm, mute/test)
facts: T/S E terminal 8 is a FUSED terminal feeding the PC Card from EMERGENCY BAT +24V — built-in replaceable fuse, note as troubleshooting culprit (exact rating: capture at inspection).

T/S C terminals 1-6 receive six status taps (PORT XA41-04, STBD XA41-02, XA41-06, XA61-30, XA61-28, XA61-26) that the PC Card's diode matrix converts into five annunciated bilge-alarm zones: LAZARETTE BILGE, AFT BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, FWD BILGE, SAIL LOCKER.

A common horn/buzzer with MUTE (S15) and TEST (S14) switches, plus a separate ALARM MOD horn/speaker, are driven off the diode/relay bank — general alarm annunciation infrastructure, not tied to one equipment.
T/S C terminals 19/20 carry the RUN IND. taps for Mast Bilge Pump and Aux Engine Room Bilge Pump status lamps, routed via multi-core cable MU4-12 from the FWD panel area.
T/S B junction block (G,3,4,5) is a pass-through/junction between T/S F override-switch taps and other terminal strips — panel wiring infrastructure only.
